server.title: Motion
server.description: Create and revise AI videos, check render status, and manage Motion credits.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
The connected account’s web-app and API chats are available through `list_chats`, `get_chat`, and `list_chat_messages`. Chat tools accept a chat ID or Motion chat URL; `get_chat` returns the latest export. Use `list_chat_exports` to retrieve all saved video exports and `get_chat_export` to renew an exact export’s download link. Links expire after one hour; saved videos remain available, and reading them does not spend credits. `get_session_status` also accepts web-app chat IDs and URLs.
Use Motion to create or edit videos, including animations, promos, ads, explainers, demos, and social clips. Motion handles research, production, and rendering.
`create_video` takes a brief: goal, source URL or text, audience, tone, and key points. Motion chooses the shots. Omit engine to use GVA 1.0 when the account has access, or Motion otherwise. GVA effort is standard (default) or extended; Motion effort is light, medium (default), or high. Choose engine, effort, and template independently; discover choices with list_engines and list_templates. Optional inputs: design_system_id, YouTube style_reference_url, aspect_ratio, duration, and attachments. Jobs are async; the widget updates progress and shows the finished video without polling. `create_followup` retains the project engine and effort.
Credits: `show_plans_and_credits` shows balance, plans, and credit packs. `purchase_credits` creates hosted checkout; the user must complete it in their browser, even with a saved card. `subscribe_to_plan` and `set_auto_topup` return Motion billing for the user to review and save changes. These links do not add credits or change settings. If structuredContent.recovery_tool is set, show that tool and wait for the user to complete payment before retrying.

tool.name: upload_asset
tool.title: Upload a local file for Motion attachments
tool.description: Get a signed upload URL for a LOCAL file (video/audio/image) so it can be used as a Motion attachment. Use this whenever the user references a file on their machine — Motion cannot read local paths (file://). Flow: 1) call this tool with the filename and content_type, 2) upload the file bytes with a shell command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" <upload_fields as -F key=value pairs> -F "file=@/path/to/local/file" "<upload_url>" (the file field MUST come last; expect HTTP 204), 3) pass the returned attachment_url in the attachments array of create_video or create_followup. The attachment_url stays valid for 7 days.

If the result's structuredContent.recovery_tool is set, show the plans and credits widget. The user must complete payment in their browser before retrying the generation. _published_faq.name: How do I add Motion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Motion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.motion.so/mcp.
